title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Farigiraf ex Cyber Judge 042/071 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Japanese Pokemon card features the rare and powerful Farigiraf ex, with a stunning full art design. It is part of the Cyber Judge set and has a card number of 042/071, making it a highly sought-after addition to any collection. The card is made of high-quality paper and has a holographic finish, adding to its overall appeal.

The card is a Stage 2 Pokemon and has a speciality of EX, making it a valuable addition to any deck. It is suitable for players aged 6 and above and is perfect for those who enjoy the Pokemon TCG game. This card is a must-have for any collector or player looking to add a rare and powerful card to their collection.
